181 repository paths scanned; 23 selected commit records inspected. SN38 PR29 merge, SN74 release, SN78 status API, SN65 live competition configuration, SN55 current implementation, SN108 active challenge and SN91 Weir benchmark checked separately.

Signed-in AlphaGap feed and leaderboard, SubnetRadar news and dated Moments, TAO Daily, TAO Media, partner accounts and both sides of the Talisman integration checked. The Grayscale custody claim was verified in the original SEC filing through the browser.

September 29–October 5 editions reviewed for duplicates, late findings, unresolved incidents and scheduled events. Market outliers and the top 12 emission recipients compared separately with selected stories.

Signed-in YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked. EY-s2-882uA public video verified at 22:09, mTJBFowN4Yo scheduled October 6 15:00 UTC, M2nWtKAkw6I latest members video retained, and NAbCyYwZ_5w public SN49 replay retained.

An overlapping pass of 30 priority public profiles ended at 2026-10-06T14:37:41.230Z; no newly exposed post after the initial scan cutoff was returned. Subsequent primary and signed-in checks extend this edition’s research cutoff to 2026-10-06T14:44:22.533Z.
accessGaps: Research cutoff 2026-10-06T14:44:22.533Z. Associated public-account samples and selected signed-in searches are not an exhaustive search of every SN-number/name. No Grok scan or complete private-community coverage is claimed.

13 repository paths returned errors and 12 public-account candidates yielded no usable sample. Directory metadata can be stale. SN55’s newly linked subnet-niome-v4 repository and SN65’s actual taofu-labs repository were checked separately; the guessed TPN-Labs path returned 404. The sundae_bar overlap alias returned 404, not a successful official-account check.

Generated briefs and AlphaGap summaries are discovery. Team-attributed burn, upgrade and environment changes remain developing without independent rollout confirmation; member allegations were not promoted as verified facts.

SN107 Minos IM2 public app availability, outside paid participation and mechanism activation were not independently verified. SN55 NIOME current code has a five-gene scope, narrower than the announcement; rewards, clinical validation and patient use were not demonstrated.

SN108 ChipForge is active with submissions but no winner; all three validators were still burning their stake at observation. SN65 TPN-005 configuration is live, but its later winner distribution was not reconstructed.

SN91 Cascade, SN23 Trishool and SN74 SparkInfer measurements were not independently rerun. Cascade’s future subnet-trained model is not part of the current ensemble. SN53 engy numerical usage and growth claims, SN44 Score break-even and buybacks, and SN33 ReadyAI annualized pace and 45% comparison are not audited financial statements.

SN78 UMI rewards remain inactive and chain submission unauthorized. SN120 Affine’s operator records and SN81 Reliquary recovery code do not independently establish wallet receipts. SN118 Ditto, SN11 TrajectoryRL, SN54 Yanez UAV and SN44 Score incidents are not independently closed. SN15 ORO’s no-false-positive statement is not an external audit; its separate Race 11 issue remains unclosed.

SN30 Endure launch remains prospective at cutoff. SN121 sundae_bar SBC30, SN114 SOMA review completion, SN61 RedTeam replacement, SN111 Claims burn proposal, SN94 permissionless access, SN104 launch, SN122 dashboard and SN25 production qualification were not confirmed activated. SN124 World Summit AI and SN10 October 8 discussion remain upcoming.

SN39 chain-derived identity says deprecated while directories use Cathedral/Basilica; its recorded inflow is not a verified relaunch or ownership transfer. SN116 Carbon’s seven-day return crosses the slot’s pre-registration history, its payout generalization retains gates, and a Discord channel claim does not establish new ownership.

SN25 UR’s 545.1k-alpha perpetual-lock change is visible in the feed, but its event detail failed to load and the block was not matched. SN106 Nodexo detail amounts differ from one feed headline; exact detail records were retained without asserting a completed sale.

Talisman’s Medium article returned a public-fetch 403; both primary X announcements and ForeverMoney’s full article were available. No bridge transfer, independent reserve audit or clinical experiment was performed. Members-only YouTube access was not bypassed.

decisions.reason: The +293.013021% day and +296.101657% week alpha/TAO changes led to primary announcement, service and actual leaderboard checks. A real active four-model NPU challenge with six submissions and five miners is covered at four stars; no winner and all-validator burning are stated. Price is not the rating basis.

The +110.943293% day and +2552.022832% week alpha/TAO moves triggered a primary validator-code review. New winner-weight authorization is covered with the commit’s held mainnet/testnet gates; the week crosses the October 4 registration and is not Carbon performance. No commercial revenue or ownership transfer is inferred.

The +16.979164% day and +21.500499% week alpha/TAO move triggered identity, channel and associated cathedral-distill repository checks. Current chain-derived metadata says deprecated; the 1315.7 TAO movement at block 9219245 is reported without relaunch, owner or confidence claims. Stale Cathedral/Basilica branding is distinguished.

editorialDecisions: Four-star selection: SN108 ChipForge challenge activation; SN65 TPN-005 live configuration; SN91 Cascade ensemble benchmark; SN107 Minos IM2 details; SN55 NIOME task launch; Talisman TAO integration; Grayscale custody filing. Price alone never earns five stars. No X post made; September 27 posting permission expired.

SN108 ChipForge: Tatsu quoted October 16, while the team’s October 5 post says October 6. The active challenge resolves the date conflict. Observed six submissions, five miners, zero winners, score to beat 50, and all three validators burning their stake. Challenge ends October 20; no awarded reward inferred.

SN65 TPN-005: live configuration starts at block 9219287; commits close at 9259180 and scoring ends at 9280780. Maximum memory is 11 GiB (11534336 KB), context 32768. Top-three split is 60/25/15 within a competition pool weighted 0.25, not 60% of all subnet emissions. Miner documentation confirms self-paid benchmarks. Secondary burn and collateral claims omitted without current chain verification.

SN107 Minos: full X article read. The October 5 evening article adds details to its September 29 conference preview; it is not a first announcement or fresh public app activation. Native Mac and iPhone apps and use of other subnet services are reported plans. No open download or outside reward verified.

SN55 NIOME: launch-linked v4 repository differs from the registry’s old repository. Current implementation has five genes and the genotype-call tier. DPYD, CYP2D6 and read tiers remain roadmap items despite the seven-gene announcement. Synthetic benchmark does not establish clinical validation or real patient use.

SN91 Cascade: Weir round 1280 has 289 series and 19 entries: 11 foundation models, two ensembles and six statistical models. Displayed lead is CRPS 0.581 and MASE 0.767. Separate static TIME claims are not conflated with the live round. Ephemeris 0.7.5 and its six-model composition checked; the subnet-trained model remains forthcoming.

Top 12 emission recipients reviewed separately: SN51, SN64, SN4, SN120, SN107, SN44, SN53, SN8, SN3, SN15, SN9 and SN80. SN51, SN120, SN107, SN44, SN53 and SN8 covered. SN64 pricing, TEE support and maintenance are operational Q&A; Kappa is an October 3 result. SN4 B300/cloud, SN3 single-GPU experiment and SN9 contest already covered. SN15 enforcement repeats October 5 without independent all-clear. SN80 allocation and Open Axis recap are older developments.

SN38 ChronoLLM PR29 merged October 5 at 16:55:25 UTC; efficiency claims were not independently benchmarked and log persistence remains a plan. SN22 Desearch code verifies API-arrival timing, not application of a 70% burn or resolution of the backlog. SN74 Gittensor compute-share code was checked; first chain application was not reconstructed and rates are not guaranteed USD returns.

SN81 Reliquary: catch-up allowance is four archive periods; update the weight setter before requeue. Original reward totals remain unchanged. Task immutability and infrastructure-failure handling are code evidence, not wallet receipts. SN97 Albedo explicitly adds SN53 GLM-5.3-Flash with GLM-5.2 fallback; pending evaluation is not declared activated.

SN33 ReadyAI: successful add_stake_burn extrinsic 9221415-0022 at October 6 04:05:36 UTC, netuid 33, amount 19240000000 rao = 19.24 TAO, with AlphaBurned and AddStakeBurn events. $95,000 is a reported annualized pace, not weekly revenue. Revenue, source of funding and the 45% buyback comparison are not independently audited.

SN44 Score officially acknowledged the Gordon interview. September break-even and buybacks remain reported claims. Apple counting is a product demonstration, not a verified packhouse customer. Manako describes current model use and a future 3D world model. Petrol-station issue has no verified closure; self-mining allegation was not adjudicated. SN53 engy usage and growth claims remain developing; SN97 code corroborates integration only.

SN87 Provenonce: public page and MIT-licensed repository show 21 attested testnet runs. Private executor leaves overall verification status UNVERIFIED. Team-operated miners, fictional fixtures and tied scores do not establish outside enrollment, mainnet revenue or a commercial market. Newly visible access and recurring weights are dated from October 4 onward.

SN120 Affine: public STATE records durable E15 step 6, resumed E16 selection of 256 from 309 with 53 held out, and seven workers during cleanup. Paired evaluation moved from 83/128 to 82/128; no convergence, future E17 or completed step 7 claimed. SN78 UMI API at block 9224532 shows 203 accepted requests, open intake, rewards false and chain authorization false despite the C5 recovery merge.

SN17 404-GEN: Round 51 winner and Round 52 intake checked. Future blocks 9229786 and 9230986 mark the effective leader and generation deadline, not today’s paid winner. Separate game-jam award claim and October 5–12 community vote are not independently reconstructed payment receipts.

SN30 Endure: October 6 target is not activation; team brief says weights are not set. SN121 sundae_bar SBC30 is unconfirmed and a meeting-assistant demo does not establish the new challenge. SN114 SOMA potential-winner review and next-contest plans do not establish completion. SN124 Swarm fixes and re-evaluation remain developing; October 7–8 World Summit AI is upcoming.

SN39 current chain identity is deprecated, conflicting with older Cathedral/Basilica directories. Its repository has no window commits. Inflow at block 9219245 does not establish ownership, customer demand or relaunch. SN116 Carbon’s Discord channel change is not a chain ownership transfer; service-key winner authorization does not remove mainnet activation gates. A generated 580 TAO summary was not converted into a $580,000 revenue claim.

SN25 UR: October 5 19:49:35.846 UTC feed records 545.1k existing alpha changing from decaying to perpetual. Detail failed to load; covered as developing due to scale, without an invented block, purchase or additional alpha. SN106 Nodexo detail rzencc shows 1814.4 alpha at block 9219520 versus the 3.6k feed headline; rzenwv shows 2983.491 alpha at block 9219495. Locks do not establish a completed sale. SN96 Verathos lock detail was not matched.

Other Moments: repeated four-hour wallet clusters deduplicated. Profitability ranks were not translated into consensus or compute power. Reported SN62 Ridges 967 TAO exit does not establish project failure. Ordinary SN116, SN51, SN41, SN9, SN44, SN49, SN53, SN50 and SN110 flows are not new business catalysts; wallet motives and ownership changes were not inferred.

SN26 Perturb next-month target remains developing without verified revenue. SN49 Nepher simulator upgrade is secondhand team attribution. SN105 Beam professional-services business is a separate entity; unnamed consultant engagement does not establish subnet revenue. October 1 patch is older and QoS remains under repair. SN72 NATIX affiliation conflicts remain unresolved. SN95 deleted impersonator apology is not a founder statement.

SN85 frame-interpolation licensing and SN75 storage/family-cap claims lack original rollout verification. SN102 cohort and 48 GB clarification are not a fresh capacity launch. SN68 delayed-payment claim lacks an independent wallet all-clear. SN100 test-node/app teaser is member-only. SN109 allegation excluded. SN63 milestone-three paper already covered September 29. Generic market commentary, politics and unrelated StonkFun excluded.

Grayscale original 8-K read in the browser: Coinbase agreement September 29, BitGo amendment September 30, filed and signed October 5. BitGo remains primary and the transfer amount is undecided. No ETF approval or retail listing asserted. Both Talisman and ForeverMoney confirm the wallet integration. CCIP security description is sourced, not an independent audit; this is not the first Base bridge.
